basic_info.description: 33-35 Fortuna Ave is vacant fixer duplex in the quiet neighborhood of Anza Vista. Each full-floor flat offers a spacious 2-bedroom 1-bath floor plan with a formal dining room, living room with a fireplace and an eat-in kitchen. Lower level has 2 seperate garage doors, each side offering 2 car tandem parking with enough space for storage, plus two additional off street parking pad. Units are individually metered for gas, water and electricity.  The upper unit offers downtown views. Good size tiered backyard       Owner can live in one unit and collect rental income from the other unit, also a great opportunity for TIC partners.
